summary_method: Native agents read file content and source structure to produce semantic summaries; no prose meaning inferred with regex or filename templates. Parent reconciles changed sources. This is not exhaustive behavioral verification of every code path or bundled dependency.
freshness: Input content hashes detect changed source bytes, not semantic correctness. Re-review changed inputs and regenerate the catalog. Native declared-fact refresh is not a universal summary updater. On 2026-11-14 all 27 hash mismatches found by the full audit at AES 8b34db8 were reconciled against current main c16eb68: for each, the recorded hash was matched to the commit that introduced it and the later commits were read. Four summaries (doc_projection.py, the lockstep-doc-facts spec, its test file, checks.txt) were reworded for the array-fact feature; the other 23 changes were docstring requirement projections, a Governs line, or regenerated planning evidence and review pages, and their existing summaries still describe them. Five tracked files added after the 419-entry inventory are listed in wiki/documents.md but are not inventory entries. Hashes detect byte change only; the 27 summaries were not independently re-reviewed beyond this diff reading.
